content.text: Epic 7: Cross-Cutting Quality, Privacy and Observability
As a product owner, I want privacy and security controls embedded in the journey so that guest information is protected.
Apply data minimization, encryption, masking, access controls, consent, retention, and secure deletion.
Sensitive data is classified and mapped to approved storage and processing locations.
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest where required.
Logs and analytics exclude or mask prohibited fields.
Access to operational data is role-based and auditable.
Retention and deletion follow approved policy.
Policy/version identifiers; no prohibited sensitive payloads
Use synthetic or approved masked test data only.
Test cases must trace to this story; defects must link back to it or its test case.

content.text: Epic 7: Cross-Cutting Quality, Privacy and Observability
As an operations user, I want traceable business and technical events so that I can diagnose failures and measure the funnel.
Create a consistent event taxonomy across search, selection, offers, cart, checkout, reservation, and email.
Events use a correlation ID across supported services.
Business events and technical logs are distinguishable.
Metrics and alerts exist for agreed critical failures and latency.
Logging degradation does not expose sensitive payloads or silently block booking unless explicitly required.
Production log access must be controlled and retained according to policy.
Never log passwords, secrets, full payment data, unmasked contact data, or raw personal-profile attributes
Use synthetic or approved masked test data only.
Test cases must trace to this story; defects must link back to it or its test case.

content.text: Epic 7: Cross-Cutting Quality, Privacy and Observability
As a guest using assistive technology, I want the booking journey to be operable and understandable so that I can complete a reservation independently.
Apply accessibility requirements throughout the journey.
Keyboard navigation, focus order, labels, instructions, status messaging, and error handling are accessible.
Visual information is not conveyed by color alone.
Email templates are readable and structurally accessible.
Accessibility test result and defect reference; no personal assistive-technology profile
Use synthetic or approved masked test data only.
Test cases must trace to this story; defects must link back to it or its test case.

content.text: Epic 7: Cross-Cutting Quality, Privacy and Observability
As a product owner, I want critical flows to meet approved service objectives so that guests can book reliably.
Define measurable service-level indicators and operational thresholds.
Search, pricing, cart, checkout, reservation, and email dependencies have agreed performance targets.
Timeout, retry, circuit-breaker, and fallback behavior are documented.
Load, resilience, and recovery tests cover critical journeys.
Reservation integrity is prioritized over non-critical personalization and analytics.
Use synthetic or approved masked test data only.
Test cases must trace to this story; defects must link back to it or its test case.
